body:
Mind set was chilled.  In my plant room chopping up a 30 year old cactus into separate buttons due to insects invading places I cannot reach. Focused on not stabbing myself to death.  A few spliffs had been burned previously. Time around midnight. I removed some flesh whilst I was chopping. Chewing very well. Four mouthfulls over about 10 mins. 10-15 after ingesting the sum total I felt a bit thick in the head. Not unpleasant like a headache. Two minutes after that a hot flush and excitability. I walked past a mirror and was a bit taken aback to find that my head,neck and torso were bright red as if I had been sunburned. Heart going like mad and head pumping but on both counts it was not unpleasant.
No visionary qualities at that dose. I was just testing the waters. My conclusion is that this cactus may have positive qualities as a medicine in the right hands at the right time. The next day I felt fantastic and full of energy. Unusually so. Peace
